verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships a live llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed by direct probe) plus extensive agent-oriented documentation: a dedicated ai-tooling doc, an MCP server doc, and a CLI --skill command that prints a vendor-authored agent guide baked into the binary. This goes beyond the minimal story requirement of just having llms.txt or agent docs. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents actually consume and act correctly on llms.txt in the wild (only vendor-side probes exist).
